items.title: Vanishing of H^1 of the structure sheaf on one curve fibre of a proper map spreads to a neighbourhood, universally
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a proper morphism f : X -> Y and a point y whose fibre has dimension at most 1 and H^1 of the structure sheaf zero, the lemma produces an open neighbourhood V of y with R^1 f_* O_X vanishing on V and still vanishing after any base change of V. The retained proof is complete: reduce to Y affine and all fibres of dimension at most 1 using openness of bounded fibre dimension (Morphisms, lemma-openness-bounded-dimension-fibres); invoke finite generation and base-change compatibility of R^1 for proper maps (Limits, lemmas proper-top-cohomology-finite-type and higher-direct-images-zero-above-dimension-fibre); translate the fibre vanishing into pM_p = M_p for the finite module M on Y = Spec A, kill M_p by Nakayama, and take a principal open where M vanishes. Retained author proof at lines 20951-20968.
